title: Long and Short
short: Compare lengths from the same start line.
trouble: Children compare the ends without lining up the starts.

blocks.html: Long and short are about how far something reaches. To compare, line them up at the same start. Which ribbon goes farther?

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Both start at the line. Which ribbon is longer?

blocks.html: Line up the starts. The one that ends farthest away is the longest.

For the grown-up: Compare spoons, pencils or socks by laying them side by side with the ends lined up. If the starts don’t match, it’s easy to be fooled, so show how to line them up. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Compare two pieces of string.
Find something longer than your hand.
Make a long snake and a short snake from play dough.
